config.rationale: Testing the token-count hypothesis: patch_size=2 yields 196 tokens (vs 49 at patch_size=4), giving self-attention 4× more relational structure to exploit. Hidden=128 with 4 heads (32-dim per head) keeps the model compact. Depth capped at 4 to avoid overfitting on 90k samples. LR kept at 3e-4 (transformer-appropriate) with AdamW and 0.05 weight decay for decoupled regularisation. Batch size 64 stabilises attention gradients with the longer sequence. Three augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90) maximise effective training diversity. This is the highest-risk candidate but tests whether the compact_transformer's 96.9% ceiling is due to token starvation.
